text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After the race, a joyful circle formed in 
the underground horse path, with everyone 
praising each other's valiant efforts.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Rickey, Acute-san! I 
actually did it today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was able to give it everything I had! 
I'm totally back to normal... no, even 
better than before!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You two are both so strong. But I secretly 
made use of my years of wisdom, too~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll show off way, waaaay more 
different running styles from now on~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(These cheers that still won't stop 
ringing out... This—sense of fulfillment.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel it... "The stage is set and 
fulfilled." Yes, this is—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My running, our running. It is truly the 
"Harmony of the Four Auspicious Beasts." 
Everyone is strong, and everyone is 
equally matched!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We stumbled along the way, but we finally 
made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I want to better myself through feng 
shui, help those around me, and reach a 
place where we can all compete happily 
together."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now I've shown the power of feng shui to 
the world! With this, I'll make everyone 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding, dong...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, what? What was that roar just now...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The roar of the Azure Dragon... right? 
Could it be... my heart's inner joy?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no?! That's not the Azure Dragon? 
This voice is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yet another... different dragon? Which 
means...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought this was enough to satisfy 
me. That's what I believed, but—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: From here, even further...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Copano Rickey called me 
out, saying there was something she 
absolutely had to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I think we talked a bit 
about this before...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the story about "dragons" 
in the world of feng shui?
choice_data_list: By dragon, do you mean the Azure Dragon?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No. What I want to talk about today isn't 
Seiryu. In the world of feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There are—two dragons, right? Another one 
besides Seiryu.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The name of that dragon is—"Huanglong".

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even above the Four Symbols. Seated at the 
very center of the throne, it is 
considered the 'King' who governs all 
creation.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since I was little, I believed in 
the Azure Dragon's blessing, wanted to be 
like the Azure Dragon, and that's how I 
got this far, but—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Deep down, she might not be satisfied yet.
choice_data_list: So your true feelings right now are...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
She is beginning to desire going from the 
"Azure Dragon" to the "Yellow Dragon." In 
other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to become stronger than Tarumae and 
Acute-san. That's the feeling that has 
begun to sprout within me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Causality has not reached its end yet. 
Tarumae is strong. Acute is strong too. 
But I...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have to surpass those two and become 
even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A feeling almost like a duty— I just 
couldn't hold it back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's eyes were deadly serious. 
I don't know what kind of feelings were 
driving her, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the Twinkle Series is a place where 
people compete to see who is the fastest. 
If you desire not just equality, but 
something beyond that—
choice_data_list:
We've got no choice but to aim to become 
the Dirt Champion.

We've got no choice but to aim to become 
the Dirt Champion.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Dirt Champion... In order to be 
recognized as that by everyone—
choice_data_list:
Let's get a complete victory over both of 
them at the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten held at Ohi at the 
year's end. It is truly the grand 
culmination of this year's racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she wins there, it will leave a strong 
impression that Copano Rickey was the 
strongest on dirt this year."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The Tokyo Daishoten... That's right. We 
must definitely win this year-end 
showdown—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand at the top! The one and 
only summit—the "Taiji"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A prepared stage sets the groundwork for 
greater leaps. Copano Rickey's next goal 
was decided.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there's still so much left for 
me to achieve. And to do that, first—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Let's definitely win the Tokyo Daishoten. 
With the combined strength of the two of 
us, plus feng shui power!"
